_about: AI-assisted research and compilation with ChatGPT (OpenAI). Entries reflect publicly documented senior figures and stated legal status as of each cited source date. No precise locations or operational route details are included. Historical Colombia person-country associations were audited against cited individual roles on 2026-09-26; three deaths and a 2016 sentence supersede stale charged cards without erasing indictment history.
